concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-metronome-guides-customers-billing-set-up-notifications-threshold-notifications]] — side-by-side route across commit and credit balance, spend and usage, and invoice-total thresholds, including seat-credit exclusions, calculation timing, payload examples, setup paths, evaluation triggers, and the merchant-action boundary
warnings: Do not imply that customer or contract balance alerts include individual seat-scoped credits; the guide excludes them from those calculations and documents a separate seat-balance type.
Do not turn example messages, upgrades, or proactive actions into automatic Metronome enforcement or merchant action.
